items.title: Acronis warns of actively exploited flaw in its cPanel backup plugin
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Acronis disclosed a high-severity Linux local privilege escalation vulnerability in its backup plugin for cPanel, WebHost Manager (WHM), and Plesk that may be exploited in the wild. [...]</article>

items.title: Malcious Admin Menu Editor Pro plugin backdoors 1,500 WordPress sites
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Malicious versions of the Admin Menu Editor Pro plugin for WordPress have been distributed to more than 200 customers after a threat actor compromised the maintainer's website and pushed updates that created a hidden user account. [...]</article>

items.title: CenterPoint Energy confirms customer data stolen in cyberattack
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>CenterPoint Energy disclosed a breach compromising some customers' personal information after an attacker leaked data allegedly stolen from the utility company. [...]</article>

items.title: BambooToken malware controls Windows and Linux systems via MQTT
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A previously unknown malware framework called BambooToken, active since at least 2023, is now using the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol to communicate with Windows and Linux systems. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers target WordPress sites via third-party WooCommerce plugin
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Hackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in the WooCommerce Wholesale Lead Capture premium plugin for WordPress to upload a PHP backdoor. [...]</article>

items.title: What Zero-Day Response Should Be in the Post-Mythos Era
items.author: Sponsored by Picus Security
items.content: <article>AI is shrinking the time between vulnerability disclosure and exploitation, leaving defenders less time to wait for patches or public exploits. Picus Security explains how exploitability validation, security control testing, and autonomous pentesting can help teams close exposure gaps before attackers arrive. [...]</article>

items.title: CISA: Critical VMware RCE flaw now exploited by ransomware gangs
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned security teams that ransomware gangs have now joined ongoing attacks exploiting a critical VMware vCenter vulnerability patched in July. [...]</article>

items.title: Suspected Black Axe gang leaders face cybercrime charges in the US
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Five alleged leaders of the Black Axe cybercrime syndicate, known for its involvement in global-scale cyber-enabled financial fraud, have been extradited to the United States to face wire fraud and money laundering charges. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft confirms KB5002914 Excel update breaks copy and paste
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has confirmed that copy and paste may silently fail for some Excel users after installing the September 2026 KB5002914 security update. [...]</article>

items.title: Cisco patches Secure Email Gateway zero-day exploited in attacks
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Cisco warned customers to patch a critical Secure Email Gateway zero-day security flaw that threat actors have been exploiting in attacks. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft releases emergency Windows updates to fix RDS failures
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Microsoft has released emergency out-of-band Windows updates to fix Remote Desktop Services failures caused by this month's security updates, along with Hyper-V and USB audio problems on some Windows versions. [...]</article>

items.title: Japan's Digital Agency says VPN flaw exposed 246,000 personnel records
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Japan's Digital Agency has discovered a data breach that may have exposed around 246,000 record rows containing personal information of government employees. [...]</article>

items.title: Homebrew 7.0.0 gets built-in GUI, better security controls
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Homebrew package manager version 7.0.0 has been released with a built-in vulnerability scanner, stronger security controls, and the full release of its native BrewUI graphical interface. [...]</article>

items.title: Twitch extension with 30K installs exposes users’ OAuth tokens
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A browser extension called Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot, available in the official Chrome and Firefox stores, sends users' Twitch OAuth session tokens to a commercial bot service. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers hijack HBO Max Reddit account to push malware in ClickFix ads
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Hackers compromised HBO Max's official Reddit account and used it to push malicious ads that launched ClickFix attacks to infect Windows and macOS devices with information-stealing malware. [...]</article>
